title: Approvals
notAuthorized: You are not authorized to review agent proposals.
notEnabled: Agent actions are not enabled on this instance.
stepUp: Approving needs a fresh second factor
stepUpHelp: Enter a new code from your authenticator app. Recovery codes cannot be used for step-up. (Preview.)
off: Agent actions are turned off by the tenant.
suspended: Agent actions are suspended by the operator.
policyOff: The published policy does not enable agent actions.
offConfirm: Turn off agent actions for this tenant? Pending proposals will end.
agentRationale: Rationale written by the agent (untrusted text)
approveConfirm: Approve the displayed action for {{count}} targets with impact {{impact}}?
approveFinalConfirm_ALARM_ACK: This is the final approval. Approving will carry out the action: acknowledge these {{count}} alarms with impact {{impact}}, as you, the approving person. Continue?
approveFinalConfirm_ALARM_CLEAR: This is the final approval. Approving will carry out the action: clear these {{count}} alarms with impact {{impact}}, as you, the approving person. Continue?
refused: The action was refused. Nothing was changed; no alarms were acknowledged or cleared.
dependencyChanged: The alarms have changed since this proposal was created (DEPENDENCY_CHANGED). Review the alarms and request a new proposal if needed.
refusalReason: An execution check refused the action: {{reason}}.
suspendedReason: The operator has suspended agent actions ({{reason}}).
policyRefusalReason: The current agent policy does not allow this action ({{reason}}).
concurrentApproval: Someone else is approving or deciding this proposal. Refreshing its state; review the updated proposal before trying again.
executionUnavailable: This server does not support carrying out the final approval. It was not recorded and no alarms were changed. Refreshing the proposal.
noteTooLong: The note must be at most 512 bytes.
stepUpInvalid: Code not accepted. Try a new authenticator code; repeated attempts may temporarily lock verification.
stepUpSuccess: Second factor verified. Retry your action.
stepUpUnavailable: In-session verification is unavailable. Sign in again to continue.
